titleFront: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time (V)
titleBack: Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you control at least 3 Bespin locations AND opponent controls fewer than 3 Bespin locations. SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on both control checks.

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged (automatic, singleton trigger, GameTextActionId.OTHER_CARD_ACTION_4)
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls MORE Bespin locations than you (strict comparative count of top locations on table).

children.req: comparative control-count: opponent-controlled Bespin locations > owner-controlled Bespin locations
children.gameConditions: Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Bespin_location, Filters.controls(opponent, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE))) > Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Bespin_location, Filters.controls(playerId, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)))

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: CONTROL-count semantics on both legs (GameConditions.controls with count 3), no 'with' actor filter, no occupy. Opponent constraint is 'fewer than 3', not zero: opponent may hold up to 2 Bespin locations and you still flip.
flipToFront: strict comparative CONTROL-count (opponent > you) via Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable, NOT a fixed threshold. Ties hold the back; parity is enough to stay flipped.
typedIdentities: Filters.or(Filters.Admirals_Order, Filters.and(Icon.DEATH_STAR_II, Filters.Executor)) (owner deploy ban, both sides, remainder of game)
Filters.and(Filters.your(playerId), Filters.Lando, Filters.movableAsRegularMove(...)) (control-phase free move, both sides)
Filters.or(Filters.Dark_Deal, Filters.Vaders_Bounty, Filters.and(Icon.SPECIAL_EDITION, Filters.Bespin_system)) (once-per-turn upload, both sides)

Back: Filters.or(Filters.Sense, Filters.Alter) (play ban, both players); Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.Lando, Filters.Lobot))) (drain-bonus protection); Filters.Vader at Filters.Bespin_location (Admiral's Orders text cancel); Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.alien, Filters.with(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Imperial, Filters.participatingInBattle))) (total battle destiny +2); Filters.Lobot participatingInBattle (2x destiny tweak)

keyCharacterFilter is null: Lando/Lobot power the back's toolkit (move, drain-bonus protection, destiny tweak) and Vader gates the Admiral's Orders cancel; none represented (arguably acceptable since the flip law itself is pure location control).
